arxiv-2006-16340.title: A Nonmonotone Matrix-Free Algorithm for Nonlinear Equality-Constrained Least-Squares Problems Thanks: Version of August 7, 2026.
arxiv-2006-16340.creator: E. Bergou, Y. Diouane, V. Kungurtsev, C. W. Royer
arxiv-2006-16340.description: Abstract Least squares form one of the most prominent classes of optimization problems, with numerous applications in scientific computing and data fitting. When such formulations aim at modeling complex systems, the optimization process must account for nonlinear dynamics by incorporating constraints.

arxiv-2101-11048.title: Large-scale optimization with linear equality constraints using reduced compact representation Thanks: Dedicated to Dr Oleg Burdakov, 1953–2021. Version of August 8, 2026. Submitted to SISC 2021.
arxiv-2101-11048.creator: Johannes J. Brust, Roummel F. Marcia, Cosmin G. Petra, Michael A. Saunders
arxiv-2101-11048.description: Abstract For optimization problems with linear equality constraints, we prove that the (1,1) block of the inverse KKT matrix remains unchanged when projected onto the nullspace of the constraint matrix . We develop reduced compact representations of the limited-memory inverse BFGS Hessian to compute search directions efficiently when the constraint Jacobian is sparse .

arxiv-2207-05080.title: Learning an evolved mixture model for task-free continual learning
arxiv-2207-05080.creator: Fei Ye, Adrian G. Bors
arxiv-2207-05080.description: Abstract Recently, continual learning (CL) has gained significant interest because it enables deep learning models to acquire new knowledge without forgetting previously learnt information. However, most existing works require knowing the task identities and boundaries, which is not realistic in a real context.

arxiv-2209-00603.title: Tolerance Analysis of Octave Bandwidth Millimeter-Wave Planar Orthomode Transducer
arxiv-2209-00603.creator: Johannes Hubmayr, Jason E. Austermann, James A. Beall, Jake A. Connors, Shannon M. Duff, Jeffrey J. McMahon
arxiv-2209-00603.description: Abstract Planar Orthomode Transducers (OMTs) are commonly used for polarization measurements at millimeter wavelengths. We present an optical coupling study of an octave bandwidth planar OMT in circular waveguide based on 3D electromagnetic simulations. We quantify results through metrics such as co- and cross- polar coupling, reflection, and waveguide leakage as a function of the OMT construction geometry.

arxiv-2403-11450.title: Zero-shot Compound Expression Recognition with Visual Language Model at the 6th ABAW Challenge
arxiv-2403-11450.creator: Jiahe Wang, Jiale Huang, Bingzhao Cai, Yifan Cao, Xin Yun, Shangfei Wang
arxiv-2403-11450.description: Abstract Conventional approaches to facial expression recognition primarily focus on the classification of six basic facial expressions. Nevertheless, real-world situations present a wider range of complex compound expressions that consist of combinations of these basics ones due to limited availability of comprehensive training datasets.

arxiv-2407-06821.title: Interference of ultrahigh frequency acoustic phonons from distant quasi-continuous sources
arxiv-2407-06821.creator: Chushuang Xiang, Edson Rafael Cardozo de Oliveira †, Sathyan Sandeep, Konstantinos Papatryfonos, Martina Morassi, Luc Le Gratiet, Abdelmounaim Harouri, Isabelle Sagnes, Aristide Lemaitre, Omar Ortiz, Martin Esmann, Norberto Daniel Lanzillotti-Kimura
arxiv-2407-06821.description: Abstract The generation of propagating acoustic waves is essential for telecommunication applications, quantum technologies, and sensing. Up to now, the electrical generation has been at the core of most implementations, but is technologically limited to a few gigahertz. Overcoming this frequency limit holds the prospect of faster modulators, quantum acoustics at higher working temperatures, nanoacoustic sensing from smaller volumes.

arxiv-2409-07815.title: More than just a Tool: People’s Perception and Acceptance of Prosocial Delivery Robots as Fellow Road Users DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Workshop on Robo-Identity: Designing for Identity in the Shared World; March 11, 2024; Boulder, CO
arxiv-2409-07815.creator: Vivienne Bihe Chi, Elise Ulwelling, Kevin Salubre, Shashank Mehrotra, Teruhisa Misu, Kumar Akash
arxiv-2409-07815.description: Abstract . Service robots are increasingly deployed in public spaces, performing functional tasks such as making deliveries. To better integrate them into our social environment and enhance their adoption, we consider integrating social identities within delivery robots along with their functional identity.

arxiv-2507-14625.title: VTarbel: Targeted Label Attack with Minimal Knowledge on Detector-enhanced Vertical Federated Learning Journal: TOSN CCS: Security and privacy Distributed systems security CCS: Computing methodologies Distributed artificial intelligence
arxiv-2507-14625.creator: Juntao Tan, Anran Li, Quanchao Liu, Peng Ran, Lan Zhang
arxiv-2507-14625.description: Abstract . Vertical federated learning (VFL) enables multiple parties with disjoint features to collaboratively train models without sharing raw data. While privacy vulnerabilities of VFL are extensively-studied, its security threats—particularly targeted label attacks—remain underexplored. arxiv-2511-02292.title: Benchmarking Non-perturbative Many-Body Approaches in the Exactly Solvable Hatsugai-Kohmoto Model
arxiv-2511-02292.creator: Hui Li, Ziyu Li, Run-yu Chen
arxiv-2511-02292.description: Abstract The accurate simulation of strongly correlated electron systems remains a central challenge in condensed matter physics, motivating the development of various non-perturbative many-body methods. Such methods are typically benchmarked against the numerical exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) in the Hubbard model; however, DQMC is limited by the fermionic sign problem and the uncertainties of numerical analytic continuation.

pmc-10517456.title: A survey of Australian women’s digital media usage in pregnancy and labour and birth
pmc-10517456.creator: Ilyana Mohamed Hussain, Nicki Hartney, Linda Sweet
pmc-10517456.description: BackgroundGiven the rapid growth of digital media resources, it is worth exploring childbearing women’s use of digital media to address their information needs. The aim of this study was to explore the use of digital media during pregnancy and birth in the local population of Western Victorian women in Melbourne, Australia.MethodsA descriptive exploratory approach was used.

pmc-10621957.title: A systematic review of the effectiveness and implementation readiness of psychosocial interventions for psychosis in South Asia
pmc-10621957.creator: Sophie Lyles, Zahra Khan, Onaiza Qureshi, Madiha Shaikh
pmc-10621957.description: BackgroundLittle is known about the effectiveness and implementation of psychosocial interventions for psychosis in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). In South Asia, specialist psychiatric resources are scarce. Support for psychosis often falls on the family or caregiver which can increase feelings of burden, impact caregivers’ wellbeing, and increase mental health stigma.

pmc-10710943.title: Identification of two phthalide derivatives and an oxindole compound isolated from the edible mushroom Pleurotus ostreatus and their inhibitory activities against plant pathogenic microorganisms
pmc-10710943.creator: Enrico M. Cabutaje, Kotomi Ueno, Kumiko Osaki-Oka, Kazutaka Kido, Thomas Edison E. dela Cruz, Atsushi Ishihara
pmc-10710943.description: The excessive use of chemical pesticides in agricultural fields for controlling plant pathogenic microorganisms harms human health, the environment, and other beneficial microorganisms in the soil and plants. To address this challenge, it is essential to isolate and discover bioactive compounds from biological resources that could inhibit plant pathogenic microorganisms.

pmc-12660044.title: Development of the 2024 Korean Guidelines for the Justification of Patient Imaging
pmc-12660044.creator: Chi-Hoon Choi, 치훈 최
pmc-12660044.description: ObjectivesThis study reports on the development and clinical applicability of the 2024 revised Korean Guidelines for the Justification of Patient Imaging with the goal of reducing unnecessary radiation exposure, thereby improving patient safety and quality of care.MethodsA multidisciplinary team from six divisions developed the guidelines using the GRADE-ADOLOPMENT framework and patient/problem, intervention, comparator, outcome (PICO) structure.

pmc-13009338.title: Immuno-Inflammatory Mechanisms in the Chronification of Pain
pmc-13009338.creator: Marcelo A. A. Moncada, Marco A. Narvaez Tamayo, Miguel A. Narvaez Encinas, Matteo Luigi Giuseppe Leoni, Giustino Varrassi
pmc-13009338.description: Chronic pain affects 20% of the global population, with current treatments achieving meaningful relief in less than 30% of patients. Growing evidence indicates that immuno-inflammatory mechanisms critically mediate the transition from acute to chronic pain, extending beyond sustained nociceptive input.

pmc-13031030.title: CXCL10 Regulates Pressure Overload–Induced Heart Failure
pmc-13031030.creator: Fernando Souza-Neto, Preston Le, Mobeen Abdrabbo, Ashab Alamgir, Haiguang Wang, Natalia Ferreira de Araujo, Jennifer L Mikkila, Bruno Sanches, Preethy Parthiban, Ryan Moon, Adam Herman, Andrew B Adams, Kurt W Prins, Silvia Guatimosim, Nathan Schuldt, Xavier S Revelo, Jop H van Berlo
pmc-13031030.description: Visual AbstractKey Words: cardiac dysfunction, cardiac remodeling, fibrosis, hypertrophy, inflammation, macrophages, T cells Heart failure (HF) is one of the leading causes of morbidity and mortality in the United States as well globally.1, 2, 3, 4 It is now well established that immune cells contribute to the development, progression, and exacerbation of HF.

pmc-13458765.title: A Multimodal fNIRS–EEG Dataset for Unilateral Limb Motor Imagery
pmc-13458765.creator: Lufeng Feng, Baomin Xu, Haoran Zhang, Bihai Lin, Zuxuan Deng, Sidi Tao, Chenyu Liu, Shifan Jia, Li Duan, Ziyu Jia
pmc-13458765.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Unilateral limb motor imagery (MI) plays an important role in upper-limb motor rehabilitation and precise control of external devices, and places higher demands on spatial resolution. However, most existing public datasets focus on binary- or four-class left–right limb paradigms that mainly exploit coarse hemispheric lateralization, and there is still a lack of multimodal datasets that simultaneously record electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) for unilateral multi-directional MI.

pmc-13486788.title: Associations between Red Blood Cell Folate Forms and Demographic, Physiologic, and Lifestyle Factors in the United States Population: Cross-Sectional Data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey August 2021–August 2023
pmc-13486788.creator: Zia Fazili, Christine M Pfeiffer, Maya R Sternberg, Phuong Ngac, Ming Zhang, Krista S Crider, Jacqueline Leachman, Anne Williams, Jaime J Gahche, Neelima Paladugula, Kelly Hong, Christina Fischer
pmc-13486788.description: BackgroundRed blood cell (RBC) total folate (TFOL) is an indicator of long-term folate status. Data on RBC folate forms are lacking. They may inform associations with health-related indicators.ObjectivesWe aimed to describe associations between RBC folate forms and different factors in the United States population.
